english: What this line is actually saying though is that-when we realize that nothing has any nature of its own-it's like that hair on the sink for someone whose eyes are perfectly fine. That is, the appearance of the hair has faded away into nothing; we don't see the hair at all. And it's the same process here, for that realization.
